note: One entry per immutable iteration. Entries are append-only: a published directory is never edited, and a superseded entry keeps its link so a figure quoted from it can still be found.

iterations.title: Electrification Workbench
iterations.feature: The paper's five relations, live: average power, peak at a stated load factor, load factor measured from a published peak, nameplate at a capacity factor, and displaced fuel converted through useful output.

iterations.title: Firm Capacity Workbench
iterations.feature: N-1 firm capacity for a transformer bank, apparent power from a stated power factor, and a demand assessed against firm rather than installed capacity. Exposes the gap where most connection refusals actually live.

iterations.title: Diversity Workbench
iterations.feature: After Diversity Maximum Demand for a group of like loads, coincidence measured from a group peak rather than assumed, and the average across a delivery window kept separate from the peak inside it.

iterations.title: Connection Cap Workbench
iterations.feature: A demand profile against a stated connection cap: peak excess, energy above the cap, and the battery power and installed energy that keep the site inside it after round-trip efficiency and depth of discharge.

iterations.title: Route Obstacles Workbench
iterations.feature: Declared crossings for a cable route: which obstacles cannot be open-cut, what each trenchless crossing costs in length once setbacks are counted, and a refusal to apply a highway-corridor factor to a route across open water.
